name: Shadcn Cookie Consent
summary: Cookie consent banner component for shadcn/ui with three variants and accept/decline callbacks.
description: A cookie consent component built on shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS. It comes in default, small and mini variants and exposes onAccept and onDecline callbacks; install it with the shadcn CLI or paste the component and restyle it with your own theme.
contains: three variants: default, small and mini
installs with the shadcn CLI or copy-paste
restyle with your own CSS, Tailwind config and shadcn theme
